acknowledge_unwitnessed.reason: Polled by the bring-up before VOS is raised: the twin's PWR model reads it 1 always (AET-WO-4240v D-3), so no wait is witnessed; bench row B-2 reads PWR_CSR1 after boot.
Polled after VOS Scale 2 is written: the twin's PWR model reads it 1 always (AET-WO-4240v D-3), so no wait is witnessed; bench row B-2 reads PWR_D3CR after boot.
No model: the twin presents level 3 itself (4230 FEEDBACK section 2 m1). FAB-NOTES programs it by read-modify-write of OPTSR as read; the bench row reads bits 3:2 back as 11.
PA8 at AF1 for TIM1_CH1 (MOTOR1), PA9/PA10 at AF7 for USART1: Renode routes PA8 by AFR (4300 FEEDBACK section 0) but the table cannot see its role; USART has no pin. Bench reads AFRH.
PA2/PA3 at AF7 for USART2 (CRSF), PA5-PA7 at AF5 for SPI1 (flash): Renode's USART has no pin (4300b FEEDBACK section 0); AFR routes only a timer channel. The bench row reads AFRL.
PA0 output (FLASH_CS); PA2/PA3, PA5-PA10 alternate (USART2, SPI1, MOTOR1, USART1): BSRR drives a pin whatever MODER says (4200 FEEDBACK); only PA8's TIM1 route reads it. Bench reads MODER.
PA5/PA7 medium for SPI1 at 16 MHz; PA0, PA2/PA3, PA6, PA8-PA10 low: no edge rate is modelled, and check speeds judges each fmax with svd-hal's own table, not an ir rule. Bench reads OSPEEDR.
OTYPER is not stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 10, measured): written whole, push-pull on every port A pin. The bench row reads it back, as 3302 B2 asked for GPIOB.
Written whole: no pull on PA0-PA7, PA9/PA10, nor PA11/PA12 (kept for USB); debug pulls kept (PA13 up, PA14 down, PA15 up); PA8's is the motor rule's. No pull is modelled. Bench reads PUPDR.
PB6/PB7 at AF4 for I2C1: the model routes a pin by AFR only for a timer channel (4300 FEEDBACK section 0). The bench row reads AFRL back; 3302 B2 predicted 0x44 there.
PB6/PB7, PB10/PB11 alternate for I2C1/I2C2, PB13-PB15 for SPI2, PB12 output (IMU_CS): BSRR drives a pin whatever MODER says (4200 FEEDBACK); no timer pin here. Bench reads MODER.
All low: PB6/PB7 I2C1 at 400 kHz, PB10/PB11 I2C2 at 100 kHz, PB12-PB15 SPI2 at 2 MHz. No edge rate is modelled; check speeds judges fmax with svd-hal's own table. Bench reads OSPEEDR.
OTYPER is not stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 10): PB6/PB7 (I2C1) and PB10/PB11 (I2C2, EXT) open-drain, the rest push-pull. 3302 B2 reads it on silicon; the bench row compares it.
No pull is modelled. Written whole by split: no internal pull on PB6/PB7 (the bus has 2.2 kOhm), PB4's reset pull-up kept. The bench row reads PUPDR back.
PE is set by the enable, not by silicon::i2c_cr1 (whose word has PE clear); stored, with no reaction claimed. The bench row reads PE as 1; the bus records on the bench need it.
7-bit addressing, no reload, no PEC, written 0 (AUTOEND set at run time): STM32F7_I2C.cs is not held, no reaction claimed. The bench row reads CR2 back, all but AUTOEND.
Write-1-to-clear (RM0433 Rev 9 section 47.9.8, p. 2015), so no bench row: STOPCF and NACKCF after each transfer. The next record's OK status on the bench (3302 B3) shows the clear took.
D2CKRDY: not polled (Q-F), a tag reading 0 (STM32H7_RCC.cs L175). The rest: tags or read-only flags of the RCC_CR words the HSE bring-up writes. Bench rows: HSIKERON, CSIKERON, HSEBYP, D2CKRDY.
HSE bring-up waits on HSERDY (ABM8AIG 16 MHz, 20 ms ruled) and PLL1RDY; Renode sets each with its ON bit (L185, L197). CSSHSEON is set after HSERDY: stored, no detection. Bench reads CR.
A tag in Renode (STM32H7_RCC.cs L401, reads 0 whatever is written, 4230 FEEDBACK section 2). SPI1 and SPI2 run on pll1_q here (the topology), not per_ck. The bench row reads it.
ResetClock reads them at reset before the select write; a tag (STM32H7_RCC.cs L408-410) reads 0 whatever silicon holds. The written SPI123SEL is judged by spi_words.
Left at reset (rcc_pclk2/pclk1 kernels the BRR and TIMINGR rules assume); a tag (STM32H7_RCC.cs L420-425) reads 0 whatever silicon holds. The bench row reads each.
The FPU enable in the generated Reset, outside every Kani harness; whether Renode faults a float with CPACR clear is not held. The bench row reads CP10/CP11 as full access.
A tag (STM32H7_SPI.cs L149), written 0 with TSIZE: no reload is used. The bench row reads it back as 0.
Tags in Renode (STM32H7_SPI.cs L258-266), written 0 beside EOTC; write-only, so no bench row. The boot record's flash identity, read on silicon, shows each transfer ended.
MODF is a tag (STM32H7_SPI.cs L238) and MASTER always reads 1: no mode fault in the twin. SSM|SSI before SPE is proved by Kani; the bench row reads MODF as 0 (3302 saw it 1).
Not stored by Renode's USART (4300b FEEDBACK section 0; M0, M1 measured P4.1): console USART1 on PA9/PA10, 8 data bits, FIFOEN set, no wake-up, interrupts off. The bench row reads CR1 back.
Stored with no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0): no parity, oversampling by 16, interrupts off, compared with the topology only. The bench row reads CR1 back.
STOP is the only CR2 field Renode stores (4300b FEEDBACK section 0; RXINV, TXINV measured P4.1): asynchronous, no swap, no inversion, LSB first. The bench row reads CR2 back.
One stop bit: stored, no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology only. The bench row reads CR2.STOP back as 00.
PB10/PB11 at AF4 for I2C2 (EXT, J8), PB13-PB15 at AF5 for SPI2 (IMU U5): the model routes a pin by AFR only for a timer channel (4300 FEEDBACK section 0). The bench row reads AFRH.
PC10/PC11 at AF7 for USART3 (MAVLINK, J7): Renode's USART has no pin (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), so a wrong AF still carries MAVLINK bytes in the twin. The bench row reads AFRH.
PG14/PG9 at AF7 for USART6 (WIFI, U30): Renode's USART has no pin (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), so a wrong AF still carries WIFI bytes in the twin. The bench row reads AFRH.
PC10/PC11 alternate for USART3 (MAVLINK, J7): MODER is read only on a timer route (4300 FEEDBACK section 0) and USART has no pin; the serial pin judge compares the topology. Bench reads MODER.
PG14/PG9 alternate for USART6 (WIFI, U30): MODER is read only on a timer route (4300 FEEDBACK section 0) and USART has no pin; the serial pin judge compares the topology. Bench reads MODER.
PC10/PC11 low for USART3 at 57600 baud (MAVLINK): no edge rate is modelled; check speeds judges the fmax with svd-hal's own table, not an ir rule. The bench row reads OSPEEDR back.
PG14/PG9 low for USART6 at 57600 baud (WIFI): no edge rate is modelled; check speeds judges the fmax with svd-hal's own table, not an ir rule. The bench row reads OSPEEDR back.
OTYPER is not stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 10, measured): written whole, push-pull on every port C pin, USART3's PC10/PC11 included. The bench row reads it back.
OTYPER is not stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 10, measured): written whole, push-pull on every port G pin, USART6's PG14/PG9 included. The bench row reads it back.
Written whole as 0: no pull on PC10/PC11 (USART3, MAVLINK) nor PC0 (VBAT_SENSE, ADC1 INP10), every other port C pin at reset. No pull is modelled. The bench row reads PUPDR.
Written whole as 0: no pull on PG14/PG9 (USART6, WIFI), every other port G pin at reset. No pull is modelled. The bench row reads PUPDR.
PE11/PE13/PE14 at AF1 for TIM1_CH2-4 (MOTOR2-4): Renode forwards TIM1 only while AFR picks AF1 (4300 FEEDBACK section 0), but the table cannot see a pin's role. Bench reads AFRH.
PE11/PE13/PE14 alternate for MOTOR2-4: Renode forwards TIM1's level only while MODER is AF (4300 FEEDBACK section 0); the table cannot see a pin's role, so the weaker class. Bench reads MODER.
PE11/PE13/PE14 low for MOTOR2-4 DShot600: no edge rate is modelled; check speeds judges that speed's fmax with svd-hal's own table, not an ir rule. The bench row reads OSPEEDR.
OTYPER is not stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 10, measured): written whole, push-pull on every port E pin, MOTOR2-4 on PE11/PE13/PE14 included. Bench row reads it back.
Written whole as 0 on port E but MOTOR2-4 (PE11/13/14, the motor rule's); PE9, MOTOR1 until 4300h D3 moved it to PA8, has no pull now. No pull is modelled. Bench reads PUPDR.
I2C2 runs EXT (PB10/PB11, J8) at 100 kHz: PE is set by the enable, not by silicon::i2c_cr1 (whose word has PE clear); stored, no reaction claimed. The bench row reads PE as 1.
7-bit, no reload, no PEC: 0 in I2C2's transfer code. STM32F7_I2C.cs is not held, no reaction claimed; EXT (J8) declares no device, so none runs. Bench reads all but AUTOEND.
Write-1-to-clear (RM0433 Rev 9 section 47.9.8): STOPCF|NACKCF in I2C2's transfer, held by its Kani harness only; no bench row, and EXT (J8) has no device, so no record shows a clear.
Ports C (USART3, VBAT_SENSE), E (MOTOR2-4), G (USART6, WIFI): 3302 B2 read Renode's AHB4ENR as 0x3, ports A/B; no held measurement shows C/E/G registered with its RCC. Bench reads AHB4ENR.
I2C2's clock for EXT (J8): 3302 B2 read Renode's APB1LENR as 0x00200000, I2C1 only; no held measurement shows i2c2 registered with its RCC, so the gate goes unseen. Bench reads I2C2EN.
USART6's clock for WIFI (U30): 3302 B2 read Renode's APB2ENR as 0x00001000, SPI1 only; no held measurement shows usart6 registered with its RCC, so the gate goes unseen. Bench reads USART6EN.
Written whole with SW = PLL1 by the 16 MHz HSE bring-up: SWS read-only, the rest tags (STM32H7_RCC.cs L226-236). MCO1/MCO2 0; PC9 (MCO2) is not set AF. Bench rows read all but SWS.
SPI2 to U5 (ICM-42688-P) on PB13-PB15: TSER is a tag (STM32H7_SPI.cs L149), written 0 with TSIZE, as no IMU transfer reloads. The bench row reads it back as 0.
Tags in Renode (STM32H7_SPI.cs L258-266), written 0 beside EOTC after each U5 transfer; write-only, so no bench row. U5's identity read (0x47 expected), on silicon, shows the transfers ended.
SPI2 masters U5 with PB12 a GPIO select: MODF is a tag (STM32H7_SPI.cs L238) and MASTER reads 1, so no mode fault shows in the twin. Kani proves SSM|SSI before SPE; bench reads MODF 0.
Written as MOE alone (4240b FEEDBACK): no break or dead time on MOTOR1-4. Every BDTR field is a tag (4300a FEEDBACK section 0); toggling MOE moves no observer (2302 A2-4). Bench reads BDTR.
CC1NE-CC3NE 0: no complementary output. TIM1's CH1N pins include PA7 (SPI_MOSI) and PB13 (IMU_SCK), here at AF5. Tags in Renode (4300a FEEDBACK section 0). Bench reads CCER.
CC1E-CC4E set for MOTOR1-4, CC5/CC6 off, every polarity 0: stored with no reaction claimed; Renode's output path never reads CCxP (4300 FEEDBACK section 0). The bench row reads CCER.
MOTOR1/MOTOR2 (PA8, PE11): OC1PE/OC2PE set, OCxFE/OCxCE 0, all tags; OCxM[3] is reserved in the model (4300a FEEDBACK section 0); the twin lists OCxPE unobservable. Bench reads CCMR1.
CC1S/CC2S 00 make channels 1-2 outputs for MOTOR1 (PA8) and MOTOR2 (PE11): stored (STM32_Timer.cs L425-445), no reaction claimed; the image compares the topology. Bench reads CCMR1.
MOTOR3/MOTOR4 (PE13, PE14): OC3PE/OC4PE set, OCxFE/OCxCE 0, all tags; OCxM[3] is reserved in the model (4300a FEEDBACK section 0); the twin lists OCxPE unobservable. Bench reads CCMR2.
CC3S/CC4S 00 make channels 3-4 outputs for MOTOR3 (PE13) and MOTOR4 (PE14): stored (STM32_Timer.cs L425-445), no reaction claimed; the image compares the topology. Bench reads CCMR2.
TIM1 for MOTOR1-4 DShot600: CKD and UIFREMAP written 0, outside the CR1 bits 0-7 Renode stores (CKD a tag; 4300a FEEDBACK section 0), so the twin cannot show them. Bench reads CR1.
ARPE set, edge-aligned up-count (CMS 0, DIR 0), UDIS/URS 0 for MOTOR1-4's DShot600 frames: stored (bits 0-7) with no reaction claimed; the image compares the topology. Bench reads CR1.
EGR carries UG alone for TIM1 (MOTOR1-4): CC1G-CC4G, COMG, TG, BG, B2G written 0, raising no event. Write-only, so no bench row; no held source line shows Renode's handling of them.
CRSF on USART2 (PA2/PA3, J6) at 420000: 8 data bits (M0/M1), FIFOEN set, no wake-up or mute, no DE timing, those interrupts off; none stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 0). Bench reads CR1.
CRSF is 8N1 (validate refuses other framing): PCE/PS 0, OVER8 0 (the column its tolerance check takes), interrupts off; stored, no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0). Bench reads CR1.
CRSF must be non-inverted 8N1 (4300b FEEDBACK section 0): RXINV/TXINV/SWAP are tags (P4.1, measured), so a wrong inversion on PA2/PA3 passes the twin. Only STOP is stored. Bench reads CR2.
One stop bit for CRSF 8N1 at 420000 on USART2: stored, no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology only. The bench row reads CR2.STOP back as 00.
MAVLINK on USART3 (PC10/PC11, J7) at 57600: 8 data bits (M0/M1), FIFOEN set, no wake-up or mute, no DE timing, those interrupts off; none stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 0). Bench reads CR1.
WIFI on USART6 (PG14/PG9, U30) at 57600: 8 data bits (M0/M1), FIFOEN set, no wake-up or mute, no DE timing, those interrupts off; none stored by Renode (4300b FEEDBACK section 0). Bench reads CR1.
MAVLINK 8N1 at 57600, BRR 1111: PCE/PS 0, OVER8 0 (oversampling by 16), interrupts off; stored with no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology. Bench reads CR1.
WIFI 8N1 at 57600, BRR 1111: PCE/PS 0, OVER8 0 (oversampling by 16), interrupts off; stored with no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology. Bench reads CR1.
MAVLINK on PC10/PC11: asynchronous, no swap, no inversion, LSB first, all tags or unstored (4300b FEEDBACK section 0; RXINV/TXINV measured P4.1); only STOP is stored. Bench reads CR2.
WIFI on PG14/PG9: asynchronous, no swap, no inversion, LSB first, all tags or unstored (4300b FEEDBACK section 0; RXINV/TXINV measured P4.1); only STOP is stored. Bench reads CR2.
One stop bit for MAVLINK 8N1 at 57600 on USART3 (J7): stored, no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology only. The bench row reads CR2.STOP back as 00.
One stop bit for WIFI 8N1 at 57600 on USART6 (U30): stored, no reaction claimed (4300b FEEDBACK section 0), compared with the topology only. The bench row reads CR2.STOP back as 00.
